summary: End-to-end testing of the multi-feature update (per-player ELO, admin recompute, all-time peak w/ season, matches name search, new 6-tier system, matrix click-to-highlight on both PvP and Champion matrices, player-profile rank badges, redesigned biggest-upset card with info popover and absolute mmr_gap). Backend: 5/5 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_elo_and_peak.py (per-player deltas differ for imbalanced teams and are equal for equal-MMR teammates with zero-sum preserved; 403/401 for anon on /api/admin/recompute-all; 200 + {ok:true, seasons:N} for admin; /api/stats/player/{id} returns peak_mmr_all_time + peak_season_id + peak_season_name correctly identifying the higher-peak season across two seasons). Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): all requested data-testids render and behave: tier-info-panel shows the 6 tiers in order Champion→Grandmaster→Diamond→Platinum→Gold→Silver with correct bands (1800+/1600-1799/1450-1599/1300-1449/1150-1299/0-1149); matches-search filters rows by player name (positive + negative verified); matrix-col-header/matrix-row-header toggle highlight, non-matching cells gain opacity-30, matrix-clear-highlight resets; same behavior verified on cm-* champion matrix testids; player profile exposes profile-mmr, profile-current-rank, profile-peak-rank, profile-peak-mmr and profile-peak-season (rendered 'in TEST_LB_50336e'); recap upset-info-btn opens upset-info-panel containing the 'mmr_gap + round_margin × 20' formula, upset-gap-<id> has NO leading minus (verified '25.6 MMR gap'), and upset-score-<id> renders loser (text-slate-400) BEFORE winner (text-[#00E676]) in the DOM.

minor.issue: test_match_validation.py::TestUpdateMatchValidation setup fails with 404 'Season not found' when the full suite is run under -n 2 --dist loadscope because another worker's test_leaderboard_format cleanup races with its active-season assumption. Pre-existing cross-file coupling noted in iteration_11; not introduced by this change.

action_items: (Optional, pre-existing) Decouple test_match_validation.py from the globally-active season; have it create its own TEST_ season to avoid xdist race with test_leaderboard_format.py cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_player_deltas: weight floor max(0.1, …) correctly prevents degenerate 0/0 while still differentiating teammates; zero-sum verified numerically (|sum| < 0.5). Good.

/api/admin/recompute-all is O(seasons × matches × players) and awaits each season serially inside a request handler. Fine for the current 7-season dataset but if seasons grow consider backgrounding (BackgroundTasks) or caching per-season computed deltas.

player_stats recomputes all-time peak with a nested loop that re-fetches every season's matches for the player on every call to /api/stats/player/{id}. Consider caching or persisting per-player peak when matches are recomputed.
peak_season_id stays None when the player never climbed above BASE_MMR (1200). That is correct, but the frontend already guards with `stats.peak_season_name && …` so UI remains clean.
Leaderboard tier popover: tier rows have unique keys and data-testid; MMR bands string matches spec.

Matrix/ChampionMatrix: click toggles work; opacity-30 dim selector and clear reset both verified. Nit: cell dim applies even to the highlighted row's intersection with the highlighted column — current code highlights the whole row AND column so the (row,col) intersection cell is NOT dimmed, which is the intended behavior.

Recap upset-score: inline IIFE parses `score.split('-').map(Number)` on every render — fine, but if score is malformed (e.g. '3' without '-') destructuring yields [n, NaN]; data from backend always 'A-B' so acceptable.
server.py is 1151 lines — approaching the 'split into modules' threshold flagged in the code-review guidelines. Consider extracting stats/*, admin/*, matches/* routers.

success_rate.backend: 100% on new tests (5/5); 40/45 on full suite (4 pre-existing xdist errors, 1 fixed by consolidating classes)

seed_data_creation: test_elo_and_peak.py creates and cleans up 2 TEST_ELO_* seasons, 4+ TEST_HI/LO/MIDA/MIDB/EQ_* players + a TEST_PEAK_OPP, and ~5 matches between them. Prior-iteration TEST_LB_50336e season + TEST_P*_50336e players remain in DB (owned by test_leaderboard_format cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-12 features verified. New backend test module is `backend/tests/test_elo_and_peak.py` (single TestEloAndPeak class so xdist loadscope keeps the shared test_data fixture on one worker — do NOT re-split into multiple classes or the peak-season test will see 0 matches). The pre-existing cross-file xdist race between test_match_validation.py and test_leaderboard_format.py is unresolved from iteration_11 and is unrelated to this iteration.
